# Problem types

<!-- Generated by cmd/problemdocs from the Go catalogue (ADR-0025); do not edit. -->

Every error the API answers is an RFC 9457 problem: an `application/problem+json` body with
`type`, `title`, `status`, and usually `detail`, `instance` and `requestId`.
GraphQL errors, gRPC statuses and broker RPC replies carry the same members. The `type` is
the URL of the problem's entry below; it is the same in every deployment, so clients switch on it.
A problem the HTTP status describes on its own, such as an unknown route (404), a wrong method
(405), an oversized body (413) or a fault of the service (500), has the type `about:blank`
and the status phrase as its title.

## invalid-request

- Type: `https://github.com/wilfriedago/tigerbeetle-platform/blob/develop/docs/problems.md#invalid-request`
- Title: Invalid request
- Status: 400 Bad Request

The request breaks a rule of the API: a malformed parameter or body, or a value the domain refuses. `detail` says which; for a parameter or body the service could not decode, `errors` lists each one with its `pointer` (body) or `parameter` (path, query or header).

## missing-idempotency-key

- Type: `https://github.com/wilfriedago/tigerbeetle-platform/blob/develop/docs/problems.md#missing-idempotency-key`
- Title: Idempotency-Key required
- Status: 400 Bad Request

A write that moves money (transaction, revert, hold, capture, void) was sent without an `Idempotency-Key` header.

## idempotency-key-reused

- Type: `https://github.com/wilfriedago/tigerbeetle-platform/blob/develop/docs/problems.md#idempotency-key-reused`
- Title: Idempotency-Key reused
- Status: 422 Unprocessable Entity

The `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different request. A key maps to exactly one write; use a new key for a new write.

## request-in-flight

- Type: `https://github.com/wilfriedago/tigerbeetle-platform/blob/develop/docs/problems.md#request-in-flight`
- Title: Request in flight
- Status: 409 Conflict

A write with the same `Idempotency-Key` is still running. Retry after the `Retry-After` delay with the same key and body to get its outcome.

## write-pending

- Type: `https://github.com/wilfriedago/tigerbeetle-platform/blob/develop/docs/problems.md#write-pending`
- Title: Write pending
- Status: 503 Service Unavailable

The write reached TigerBeetle but its outcome is not known yet. Retry after the `Retry-After` delay with the same key and body; the reconciler settles it in the meantime.

## write-failed

- Type: `https://github.com/wilfriedago/tigerbeetle-platform/blob/develop/docs/problems.md#write-failed`
- Title: Write failed
- Status: 422 Unprocessable Entity

The `Idempotency-Key` belongs to a write that failed before TigerBeetle saw it. Retry with a new key.

## transaction-declined

- Type: `https://github.com/wilfriedago/tigerbeetle-platform/blob/develop/docs/problems.md#transaction-declined`
- Title: Transaction declined
- Status: 422 Unprocessable Entity

TigerBeetle declined this transaction on an earlier attempt and no longer reports why. Nothing was applied; retry with a new `Idempotency-Key`.

## hold-declined

- Type: `https://github.com/wilfriedago/tigerbeetle-platform/blob/develop/docs/problems.md#hold-declined`
- Title: Hold declined
- Status: 422 Unprocessable Entity

TigerBeetle declined this hold on an earlier attempt and no longer reports why. Nothing was reserved; retry with a new `Idempotency-Key`.

## hold-resolution-declined

- Type: `https://github.com/wilfriedago/tigerbeetle-platform/blob/develop/docs/problems.md#hold-resolution-declined`
- Title: Hold resolution declined
- Status: 422 Unprocessable Entity

TigerBeetle declined this capture or void on an earlier attempt and no longer reports why. Retry with a new `Idempotency-Key`.

## exceeds-credits

- Type: `https://github.com/wilfriedago/tigerbeetle-platform/blob/develop/docs/problems.md#exceeds-credits`
- Title: Declined: exceeds credits
- Status: 422 Unprocessable Entity

A posting would take the source account's debits above its credits, which its account rule forbids. Nothing was applied: `posting` is the index of the posting that failed and `results` holds the TigerBeetle result of every posting.

## exceeds-debits

- Type: `https://github.com/wilfriedago/tigerbeetle-platform/blob/develop/docs/problems.md#exceeds-debits`
- Title: Declined: exceeds debits
- Status: 422 Unprocessable Entity

A posting would take the destination account's credits above its debits, which its account rule forbids. Nothing was applied: `posting` and `results` say where.

## already-reverted

- Type: `https://github.com/wilfriedago/tigerbeetle-platform/blob/develop/docs/problems.md#already-reverted`
- Title: Already reverted
- Status: 409 Conflict

The transaction was already reverted. A transaction is reverted at most once.

## hold-already-resolved

- Type: `https://github.com/wilfriedago/tigerbeetle-platform/blob/develop/docs/problems.md#hold-already-resolved`
- Title: Hold already resolved
- Status: 409 Conflict

The hold was already captured or voided. A hold is resolved exactly once.

## hold-expired

- Type: `https://github.com/wilfriedago/tigerbeetle-platform/blob/develop/docs/problems.md#hold-expired`
- Title: Hold expired
- Status: 409 Conflict

The hold expired on the cluster clock and TigerBeetle released it; it can no longer be captured or voided.

## capture-exceeds-hold

- Type: `https://github.com/wilfriedago/tigerbeetle-platform/blob/develop/docs/problems.md#capture-exceeds-hold`
- Title: Capture exceeds hold
- Status: 400 Bad Request

The capture asks for more than the amount the hold reserved.

## prefix-too-broad

- Type: `https://github.com/wilfriedago/tigerbeetle-platform/blob/develop/docs/problems.md#prefix-too-broad`
- Title: Prefix too broad
- Status: 422 Unprocessable Entity

The address prefix covers more accounts than one aggregate may read. Narrow the prefix.

## history-not-enabled

- Type: `https://github.com/wilfriedago/tigerbeetle-platform/blob/develop/docs/problems.md#history-not-enabled`
- Title: History not enabled
- Status: 422 Unprocessable Entity

The account was created without the history flag, so TigerBeetle keeps no balance history for it. The flag cannot be added to an existing account.

## unknown-event-type

- Type: `https://github.com/wilfriedago/tigerbeetle-platform/blob/develop/docs/problems.md#unknown-event-type`
- Title: Unknown event type
- Status: 400 Bad Request

The event type is not registered in the ledger. Create it under the ledger's event types first.

## built-in-rule

- Type: `https://github.com/wilfriedago/tigerbeetle-platform/blob/develop/docs/problems.md#built-in-rule`
- Title: Built-in rule
- Status: 400 Bad Request

The account rule is a built-in default and cannot be deleted; put a rule with the same pattern to replace it.

## not-found

- Type: `https://github.com/wilfriedago/tigerbeetle-platform/blob/develop/docs/problems.md#not-found`
- Title: Not found
- Status: 404 Not Found

The ledger, account, transaction, hold, rule, event type or request does not exist.

## already-exists

- Type: `https://github.com/wilfriedago/tigerbeetle-platform/blob/develop/docs/problems.md#already-exists`
- Title: Already exists
- Status: 409 Conflict

A resource with the same name or pattern already exists.

## conflict

- Type: `https://github.com/wilfriedago/tigerbeetle-platform/blob/develop/docs/problems.md#conflict`
- Title: Conflict
- Status: 409 Conflict

The request conflicts with the current state of the resource.

## rejected

- Type: `https://github.com/wilfriedago/tigerbeetle-platform/blob/develop/docs/problems.md#rejected`
- Title: Rejected
- Status: 422 Unprocessable Entity

The request is valid, but the ledger refuses it.

## dependency-unavailable

- Type: `https://github.com/wilfriedago/tigerbeetle-platform/blob/develop/docs/problems.md#dependency-unavailable`
- Title: Dependency unavailable
- Status: 503 Service Unavailable

Postgres or TigerBeetle did not answer in time. Retry later; a write keeps its outcome under its `Idempotency-Key`.

## not-ready

- Type: `https://github.com/wilfriedago/tigerbeetle-platform/blob/develop/docs/problems.md#not-ready`
- Title: Not ready
- Status: 503 Service Unavailable

A dependency the service needs is down, so this instance should not receive traffic. `dependencies` reports each one.

## unauthenticated

- Type: `https://github.com/wilfriedago/tigerbeetle-platform/blob/develop/docs/problems.md#unauthenticated`
- Title: Unauthenticated
- Status: 401 Unauthorized

The call carries no access token or API key, or one that is not valid: expired, for another audience, or revoked. Send `Authorization: Bearer <token>` (ADR-0026).

## sign-in-failed

- Type: `https://github.com/wilfriedago/tigerbeetle-platform/blob/develop/docs/problems.md#sign-in-failed`
- Title: Sign-in failed
- Status: 401 Unauthorized

The console's sign-in could not be completed: it took too long, or its answer did not match the request. Start again (ADR-0030).

## forbidden

- Type: `https://github.com/wilfriedago/tigerbeetle-platform/blob/develop/docs/problems.md#forbidden`
- Title: Forbidden
- Status: 403 Forbidden

The caller is known but its role does not allow this. `detail` names the permission it lacks (ADR-0028).

## cross-site-request

- Type: `https://github.com/wilfriedago/tigerbeetle-platform/blob/develop/docs/problems.md#cross-site-request`
- Title: Cross-site request
- Status: 403 Forbidden

A request that changes state came with the console's session cookie but not from the console's own origin (ADR-0030).

## organization-required

- Type: `https://github.com/wilfriedago/tigerbeetle-platform/blob/develop/docs/problems.md#organization-required`
- Title: Organization required
- Status: 400 Bad Request

A call about a ledger named no organization. Send the organization's alias in `X-Organization` (gRPC `x-organization` metadata, broker `organization` header) (ADR-0027).

## organization-not-found

- Type: `https://github.com/wilfriedago/tigerbeetle-platform/blob/develop/docs/problems.md#organization-not-found`
- Title: Organization not found
- Status: 404 Not Found

The organization does not exist, or the caller is not one of its members (ADR-0027).

## organization-suspended

- Type: `https://github.com/wilfriedago/tigerbeetle-platform/blob/develop/docs/problems.md#organization-suspended`
- Title: Organization suspended
- Status: 403 Forbidden

The organization is suspended: no call can act for it until staff lift the suspension (ADR-0027).

## unsupported-media-type

- Type: `https://github.com/wilfriedago/tigerbeetle-platform/blob/develop/docs/problems.md#unsupported-media-type`
- Title: Unsupported media type
- Status: 415 Unsupported Media Type

The request body is not sent as `application/json` (ADR-0032).

## unknown-method

- Type: `https://github.com/wilfriedago/tigerbeetle-platform/blob/develop/docs/problems.md#unknown-method`
- Title: Unknown method
- Status: 404 Not Found

The broker RPC message names a method the service does not have.

## deadline-exceeded

- Type: `https://github.com/wilfriedago/tigerbeetle-platform/blob/develop/docs/problems.md#deadline-exceeded`
- Title: Deadline exceeded
- Status: 503 Service Unavailable

The broker RPC deadline passed before the request ran; it was not executed.

## TigerBeetle results

A posting TigerBeetle declines for a reason the platform does not name itself is reported under
the name of its result, the dashes standing for underscores. Most of these mean a request the
API should have refused first; report one as a bug.

### linked-event-chain-open

- Type: `https://github.com/wilfriedago/tigerbeetle-platform/blob/develop/docs/problems.md#linked-event-chain-open`
- Title: Linked event chain open
- Status: 422 Unprocessable Entity

TigerBeetle declined a posting with the result `linked_event_chain_open`. Nothing was applied: `posting` is the index of the posting that failed and `results` holds the result of every posting. TigerBeetle documents the result at https://docs.tigerbeetle.com/reference/requests/create_transfers/#linked_event_chain_open.
